title: LINC00520 Regulates VDAC1 Oligomerization to Promote Cisplatin Resistance in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Platinum-based chemotherapy remains the primary treatment for lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), although its efficacy is frequently limited by acquired cisplatin resistance. title: Inhibition of G6PD-Mediated MAPK Signaling Triggers Mitochondrial Apoptosis and Cell Cycle Arrest in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
snippet: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) has been implicated in tumor progression. This study investigated the biological role of G6PD in the malignant progression of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and explored the underlying molecular mechanisms.
